{"parentUuid":"3b820734-137e-4d14-9d3b-25202e82798a","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"83e44df3-dae7-441a-a7fa-584ff07b6328","agentId":"a0f24bf34ba67138d","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"<command-message>crucible</command-message>\n<command-name>crucible</command-name>\n<skill-format>true</skill-format>"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/skills/crucible\n\n# CRUCIBLE — operating the engine\n\nCRUCIBLE turns an authorized seed URL into **oracle-confirmed** findings, reasons over them,\nand produces auditable reports — inside a fail-closed safety stack. Its whole value is one\nrule; internalize it before anything else:\n\n> **A claim is a FACT only when a deterministic oracle fires over data a real target\n> produced.** You (the LLM) ADVISE where to look and what a result might mean; the oracle\n> CONFIRMS. Nothing else — not your confidence, not a critic's endorsement, not a plausible\n> story — promotes a claim to a fact.\n\nThe standing doctrine every reasoning call operates under is\n[framework/cognitive/metacognition.md](../../../framework/cognitive/metacognition.md) (it is\ninjected into every LLM system prompt). The full architecture — agents, event spine, veracity\nlayer, learning/metacognition core, safety stack — is\n[framework/v2/docs/CRUCIBLE-AI.md](../../../framework/v2/docs/CRUCIBLE-AI.md). The binding\nconstitution is [CLAUDE.md](../../../CLAUDE.md); never relax scope, destruction, evidence, or\nhonesty rules.\n\n## The invariants (never violate these)\n\n1. **Oracle authority.** Only a fired oracle confirms. Critics/RL/reflection/self-consistency\n   may only *advise, re-rank, defer, or abstain* — never promote a finding or override the oracle.\n2. **Coverage.** Never silently skip an authorized attack surface. Learning and reflection\n   *deprioritise* (re-rank / defer); they never gate a surface out.\n3. **Prove by re-execution.** A finding is a fact only if its retained `oracle_context`\n   re-fires. The veracity firewall (`framework/v2/veracity/`) re-runs proofs; it can only demote.\n4. **Non-circular learning.** An EXPLOITABLE label needs ≥2 independent corroborating oracle\n   kinds; a silent oracle is never auto-labelled a false positive.\n5. **Refuse honestly, fail closed.** Decline to conclude what you cannot ground; record every\n   refusal as evidence. Hard limits (scope, authorization, destruction, real user data) are\n   inviolable — when unsure, stop and ask.\n6. **Determinism + append-only.** No wallclock/global-rng in learning/reward math; the event\n   spine is append-only (supersede, never edit).\n\n## Structured workflows\n\n### Run an authorized engagement (end-to-end, gated)\n1. Confirm the active target's `targets/<slug>/charter.md` authorizes it (constitution §II).\n2. `python3 -m framework.v2 engage <slug> <seed-url> [--recon] [--spine]`\n   — crawls, audits, confirms via oracles, chains attack paths, scores confidence, and\n   (with `--spine`) mirrors the whole run onto the immutable blackboard event stream.\n   (`--strict-evidence` is a **`scan`**-only flag, below — not an `engage` flag.)\n3. Every request passes the full gate chain; an out-of-scope seed or tripped kill-switch\n   refuses *before* traffic and is recorded as a `refusal` event.\n\n### Loopback-only quick scan\n`python3 -m framework.v2 scan http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ --format json|sarif|html [--strict-evidence]`\n— the export states each finding's **live grounding** (fact / ungrounded / contradicted);\n`--strict-evidence` withholds non-fact findings from the rendered doc but keeps them in\n`--reverifiable-out`.\n\n### Re-verify a report (prove-don't-guess, offline)\n`python3 -m framework.v2 verify <report.json>` re-runs each finding's retained `oracle_context`.\n`python3 -m framework.v2 evidence ...` builds/verifies signed, hash-linked evidence certificates\n(and, with report claims bound in, fails closed when a report sentence has no backing evidence).\n\n### Inspect / audit the event spine\nThe blackboard (`framework/v2/agents/blackboard.py`) is the one append-only, typed, provenance-\nlinked event stream. Replay it with `Blackboard.replay(engagement=..., since_id=...)`.\nCryptographic tamper-evidence: `framework/v2/agents/spine_chain.py`\n(`build_spine_chain` / `sign_spine_head` / `verify_spine_head`).\n\n### Recon / intel, memory, self-improvement\n`python3 -m framework.v2 intel ...` (OSINT into the shared world-model; gated egress),\n`memory ...` (cross-engagement priors — never fabricate a score), `improve ...`\n(authorise-not-apply — it never self-applies a change).\n\n### Read-only operator console\n`python3 -m framework.v2 console` — loopback, read-only, zero-impact operator UI over the run.\n\n## What NOT to do\n- Do not build detection-evasion / identity-rotation / stay-hidden-from-defenders capability —\n  CRUCIBLE is correlatable and authorized by doctrine (constitution §VI).\n- Do not let any learned/critic/LLM signal enter the deterministic oracle/SCE/calibration inputs\n  or promote a finding.\n- Do not attack third parties (payment/IdP/CDN) — test only the operator's integration with them.\n"}]},"isMeta":true,"uuid":"5ec926c7-993e-4553-858d-15a0c6732ada","timestamp":"2026-07-19T21:53:18.384Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

The floor's monotonic {last_seq, base_seq, base_count} plus\n10\tthe `prev_head_hash` meta-chain catch that replay for any verifier that has ever seen a newer floor.\n11\tThe floor only ever ADDS rejections (it is checked AFTER the in-band signature check), so with no floor\n12\tpresent, or values it satisfies, behavior is byte-identical to the pre-floor spine.\n13\t\n14\tHONEST LIMIT (accepted, §1.3) — do NOT overclaim: the owner key is FS-resident AND `floor.json` is an\n15\tUNSIGNED file at 0600, so a SAME-HOST attacker with the owner's UID (or root) — even WITHOUT the Ed25519\n16\tkey — defeats the LOCAL verify path by rewriting head.json AND floor.json together (the local verify reads\n17\tthe floor fresh from that same attacker-controlled disk). The floor's real anti-rollback guarantee holds\n18\tonly for (i) the routine `--reset` path (the floor lives OUTSIDE spine/, so a spine-dir rmtree can't lower\n19\tit), (ii) an OUT-OF-BAND verifier that retained a newer floor (a paired device over WireGuard), and\n20\t(iii) an attacker who can overwrite only head.json, not the floor. A COLD verifier bootstrapping off an\n21\tuntrusted mirror that never authenticates the floor even once is unprotected — class-identical to today's\n22\tsingle-file rollback, NOT widened by pruning. Bounded (not eliminated) by seeding the initial floor over\n23\tthe authenticated WireGuard pairing channel, never the mirror.\n24\t\"\"\"\n25\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n26\t\n27\timport os\n28\tfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n29\tfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n30\tfrom pathlib import Path\n31\tfrom typing import Iterator, Optional\n32\t\n33\tfrom pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field\n34\t\n35\tfrom ..config import FLOOR_PATH, SCOPE\n36\tfrom ..reuse import SignedChainHead\n37\tfrom ..reuse.canonical import evidence_signing_bytes, sha256_hex\n38\tfrom ..reuse.chain import _head_payload\n39\tfrom .atomicio import atomic_write_text\n40\t\n41\ttry:\n42\t    import fcntl\n43\texcept ImportError:  # pragma: no cover — non-POSIX; floor advance falls back to best-effort (single host)\n44\t    fcntl = None  # type: ignore[assignment]\n45\t\n46\t\n47\tclass FloorDowngrade(ValueError):\n48\t    \"\"\"The INTENDED refusal: an advance whose head would lower the floor / break the meta-chain (e.g. a\n49\t    stale concurrent signer, or re-signing a shorter spine after a reset). Distinct from a load/write\n50\t    FAILURE (a corrupt or wrong-scope floor, an IO error) so `checkpoint()` can treat this one as benign\n51\t    (warn) while surfacing a genuine failure loudly.\"\"\"\n52\t\n53\t\n54\tclass Floor(BaseModel):\n55\t    \"\"\"The persisted anti-rollback watermark. Non-secret (hashes + seqs), but written 0600 as\n56\t    defense-in-depth. `head_sig_hash` is the meta-chain identity of the CURRENT accepted head. The\n57\t    monotonic quantity is `entry_count` (ABSOLUTE = base_count + live, unchanged across a prune) — it,\n58\t    not `last_seq`, is the sound rollback guard: `last_seq` is 0-indexed and is 0 for BOTH an empty spine\n59\t    and a 1-record spine, so a 1->0 rollback would slip past a last_seq-only check.\"\"\"\n60\t    model_config = ConfigDict(extra=\"forbid\")\n61\t    schema_version: int = 1\n62\t    scope: str\n63\t    entry_count: int = Field(ge=0)   # ABSOLUTE record count — the primary monotonic anti-rollback quantity\n64\t    last_seq: int = Field(ge=0)\n65\t    base_seq: int = Field(ge=0)\n66\t    base_count: int = Field(ge=0)\n67\t    head_sig_hash: str\n68\t    updated_ts: str = \"\"\n69\t\n70\t\n71\tdef head_sig_hash(head: SignedChainHead) -> str:\n72\t    \"\"\"The identity of an ACCEPTED head in the meta-chain: sha256 of its owner-signing bytes (the SAME\n73\t    bytes `verify_threshold` checks) — a hash-space distinct from `head_hash` (which hashes the chain\n74\t    tip). A v1 head hashes its v1 payload (v2 fields dropped by `_head_payload`), so the hash a v2\n75\t    first-prune head names as `prev_head_hash` matches the recorded floor exactly across the schema bump.\n76\t    \"\"\"\n77\t    return sha256_hex(evidence_signing_bytes(_head_payload(head)))\n78\t\n79\t\n80\tdef load_floor(path: Optional[Path] = None) -> Optional[Floor]:\n81\t    \"\"\"Read the durable floor. `None` if ABSENT (pre-floor / never-signed spine — floor checks are then\n82\t    skipped, byte-identical to before). RAISES on a PRESENT-but-unreadable floor: a corrupt or\n83\t    forbid-violating floor is suspicious (tamper / partial write survived), and must never be silently\n84\t    treated as absent — that would be a fail-open un-flooring. Callers on the verify path catch the raise\n85\t    and fail CLOSED with a distinct message; they never treat it as clean.\"\"\"\n86\t    p = Path(path) if path is not None else FLOOR_PATH\n87\t    if not p.exists():\n88\t        return None\n89\t    fl = Floor.model_validate_json(p.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n90\t    if fl.scope != SCOPE:\n91\t        # A floor for a DIFFERENT scope must not silently govern this spine (a swapped-in / cross-store\n92\t        # floor). Suspicious -> raise, so the read path fails CLOSED exactly like a corrupt floor.\n93\t        raise ValueError(f\"durable floor scope {fl.scope!r} != active scope {SCOPE!r} (wrong-store floor)\")\n94\t    return fl\n95\t\n96\t\n97\tdef check_floor(head: SignedChainHead, floor: Optional[Floor]) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n98\t    \"\"\"Reject rules. A validly-signed head that nonetheless violates the durable floor is a ROLLBACK\n99\t    (stale-head replay / un-prune / older-snapshot replay), reported as TAMPERING by the caller. No\n100\t    floor -> pass (byte-identical). Pure + side-effect-free, so it is testable in isolation and shared\n101\t    by the write path (`advance_floor`'s downgrade guard, RE-loaded under the lock) and every read path.\"\"\"\n102\t    if floor is None:\n103\t        return True, \"no durable floor\"\n104\t    if head.entry_count < floor.entry_count:            # PRIMARY guard: absolute count (prune-invariant)\n105\t        return False, (f\"ROLLBACK: head entry_count {head.entry_count} < durable floor entry_count \"\n106\t                       f\"{floor.entry_count} (truncated spine / stale head replay)\")\n107\t    if head.last_seq < floor.last_seq:\n108\t        return False, (f\"ROLLBACK: head last_seq {head.last_seq} < durable floor last_seq \"\n109\t                       f\"{floor.last_seq} (stale head / truncated spine replay)\")\n110\t    if head.base_seq < floor.base_seq:\n111\t        return False, (f\"UN-PRUNE: head base_seq {head.base_seq} < durable floor base_seq \"\n112\t                       f\"{floor.base_seq} (older-snapshot replay)\")\n113\t    if head.base_count < floor.base_count:\n114\t        return False, (f\"UN-PRUNE: head base_count {head.base_count} < durable floor base_count \"\n115\t                       f\"{floor.base_count} (older-snapshot replay)\")\n116\t    if head.schema_version >= 2:\n117\t        # META-CHAIN (v2 heads only — a v1 head carries no prev_head_hash so this is dormant until the\n118\t        # first prune). This enforces CORRECT-PARENT LINKAGE: a v2 head is accepted iff it IS the recorded\n119\t        # accepted head (re-verify) OR links to it via prev_head_hash (its child). It blocks replay of a\n120\t        # stale head from a PRIOR prune generation and any head that does not descend from the accepted\n121\t        # one. NOTE: true SINGLE-SUCCESSOR uniqueness (rejecting a second, different owner-signed child of\n122\t        # the same parent) is NOT enforced here — that requires the pre-committed snapshot_seq cross-check\n123\t        # landing in Slice D/E; here the monotonic entry_count/base_* guards already bound a sibling.\n124\t        if head_sig_hash(head) != floor.head_sig_hash and head.prev_head_hash != floor.head_sig_hash:\n125\t            return False, (\"META-CHAIN BREAK: v2 head neither is the recorded accepted head nor descends \"\n126\t                           \"from it (stale/forked owner-signed head replay)\")\n127\t    return True, \"within durable floor\"\n128\t\n129\t\n130\t@contextmanager\n131\tdef floor_lock(path: Optional[Path] = None) -> Iterator[None]:\n132\t    \"\"\"Exclusive CROSS-PROCESS lock serializing a floor advance (and the head write that precedes it in\n133\t    checkpoint()) so the load->check->write triple is ATOMIC and last-writer-MONOTONIC, not\n134\t    last-writer-wins. Without it, two racing checkpoint() callers each read a STALE prior floor, both pass\n135\t    the downgrade guard, and the later os.replace can roll the floor BACKWARDS — opening a false-CLEAN\n136\t    window for a stale-head replay. Binds the flock to a sibling lockfile's inode (survives the atomic\n137\t    replace of floor.json). Best-effort where fcntl is absent (single-host assumption).\"\"\"\n138\t    p = Path(path) if path is not None else FLOOR_PATH\n139\t    lockp = p.parent / (p.name + \".lock\")\n140\t    lockp.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n141\t    fd = os.open(str(lockp), os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT, 0o600)\n142\t    try:\n143\t        if fcntl is not None:\n144\t            try:\n145\t                fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)\n146\t            except OSError:  # pragma: no cover — lock unsupported on this fs; best-effort\n147\t                pass\n148\t        yield\n149\t    finally:\n150\t        os.close(fd)\n151\t\n152\t\n153\tdef _write(floor: Floor, path: Optional[Path]) -> Floor:\n154\t    p = Path(path) if path is not None else FLOOR_PATH\n155\t    atomic_write_text(p, floor.model_dump_json(), prefix=\".floor-\")\n156\t    try:\n157\t        os.chmod(p, 0o600)\n158\t    except OSError:  # pragma: no cover — non-POSIX / unusual fs; content is non-secret, mode is best-effort\n159\t        pass\n160\t    return floor\n161\t\n162\t\n163\tdef _now_iso() -> str:\n164\t    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n165\t\n166\t\n167\tdef _floor_of(head: SignedChainHead) -> Floor:\n168\t    return Floor(scope=SCOPE, entry_count=head.entry_count, last_seq=head.last_seq,\n169\t                 base_seq=head.base_seq, base_count=head.base_count,\n170\t                 head_sig_hash=head_sig_hash(head), updated_ts=_now_iso())\n171\t\n172\t\n173\tdef advance_floor(head: SignedChainHead, *, path: Optional[Path] = None, _locked: bool = False) -> Floor:\n174\t    \"\"\"Advance the durable floor to a just-committed head — UPWARD-ONLY. The load->check->write is done\n175\t    under `floor_lock` and the prior floor is RE-LOADED inside the lock, so a concurrent advance that\n176\t    already wrote a higher floor is observed and this stale write is REFUSED (raises ValueError) — making\n177\t    the floor last-writer-MONOTONIC, never last-writer-wins. Refuses to lower any monotonic field or break\n178\t    the meta-chain — the exact thing the floor exists to prevent. Written atomically\n179\t    (temp->fsync->replace->dir-fsync) at 0600, only AFTER the head has committed. `_locked=True` when the\n180\t    caller (checkpoint) already holds `floor_lock` for the same critical section — do not re-acquire.\"\"\"\n181\t    p = Path(path) if path is not None else FLOOR_PATH\n182\t    if _locked:\n183\t        return _advance_locked(head, p)\n184\t    with floor_lock(p):\n185\t        return _advance_locked(head, p)\n186\t\n187\t\n188\tdef _advance_locked(head: SignedChainHead, p: Path) -> Floor:\n189\t    prior = load_floor(p)                                # RE-LOAD under the lock — sees a racing advance\n190\t    if prior is not None:\n191\t        ok, msg = check_floor(head, prior)\n192\t        if not ok:\n193\t            raise FloorDowngrade(f\"refusing to advance the durable floor DOWNWARD/off-chain: {msg}\")\n194\t    return _write(_floor_of(head), p)\n195\t\n196\t\n197\tdef reset_floor(head: SignedChainHead, *, path: Optional[Path] = None) -> Floor:\n198\t    \"\"\"DELIBERATE downward re-seed — the ONLY path that may lower the floor. For a legitimate\n199\t    `--reset` / restore, gated by the caller: `sigil floor reset` re-signs the current spine with the\n200\t    owner key (so the new floor names a fresh owner-signed head) and requires an explicit `--yes`. No\n201\t    monotonic guard — that is the whole point — but still under `floor_lock` so it cannot interleave with\n202\t    a concurrent advance and lose its write.\"\"\"\n203\t    p = Path(path) if path is not None else FLOOR_PATH\n204\t    with floor_lock(p):\n205\t        return _write(_floor_of(head), p)\n206\t"}]},"uuid":"b873c967-a9cc-4418-8c83-e8614d8ef06b","timestamp":"2026-07-19T21:53:24.864Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"294b0bcd-ac02-4bc8-978c-3c4b30084142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

A hardware co-signer can be\n10\tadded later by raising the trust-root threshold.\n11\t\"\"\"\n12\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n13\t\n14\timport json\n15\timport os\n16\tfrom pathlib import Path\n17\t\n18\t_MAX_HEAD_SCHEMA = 2   # head schema versions this build understands; a higher one -> \"upgrade sigil\"\n19\t\n20\tfrom ..config import HEAD_PATH, KEYS_DIR, OWNER_KEY_ID, SCOPE\n21\tfrom ..reuse import (\n22\t    AuthorizerKey,\n23\t    SignedChainHead,\n24\t    TrustRoot,\n25\t    generate_keypair,\n26\t    sign_head,\n27\t    verify_head,\n28\t)\n29\tfrom .atomicio import atomic_write_text\n30\tfrom .floor import Floor, FloorDowngrade, advance_floor, check_floor, floor_lock, load_floor\n31\tfrom .store import SpineStore\n32\t\n33\t_PRIV = KEYS_DIR / \"owner.priv\"\n34\t_PUB = KEYS_DIR / \"owner.pub\"\n35\t\n36\t\n37\tdef _atomic_write_text(path: Path, data: str) -> None:\n38\t    \"\"\"Durably + atomically replace `path` with `data` (FIX 3) — a reader sees either the whole old or\n39\t    the whole new head, never a torn one, and a crash leaves the previous valid head intact. Delegates to\n40\t    the one shared `spine.atomicio.atomic_write_text` so the head, the manifest, and every cutover use the\n41\t    same audited routine (no drift).\"\"\"\n42\t    atomic_write_text(path, data, prefix=\".head-\")\n43\t\n44\t\n45\tdef _owner_keys() -> tuple[str, str]:\n46\t    if not _PRIV.exists():\n47\t        KEYS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n48\t        kp = generate_keypair()\n49\t        _PRIV.write_text(kp.private_key_b64, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n50\t        os.chmod(_PRIV, 0o600)\n51\t        _PUB.write_text(kp.public_key_b64, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n52\t    return _PRIV.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").strip(), _PUB.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").strip()\n53\t\n54\t\n55\tdef trust_root() -> TrustRoot:\n56\t    _, pub = _owner_keys()\n57\t    return TrustRoot(threshold=1, authorizers=[\n58\t        AuthorizerKey(key_id=OWNER_KEY_ID, name=\"owner\", public_key_b64=pub)])\n59\t\n60\t\n61\tdef _read_head_on_disk() -> SignedChainHead | None:\n62\t    \"\"\"The current head.json parsed, or None (absent / unparseable). Used only as a best-effort monotonic\n63\t    race guard — never a security boundary (the floor is).\"\"\"\n64\t    try:\n65\t        if not HEAD_PATH.exists():\n66\t            return None\n67\t        return SignedChainHead.model_validate_json(HEAD_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n68\t    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — a corrupt/future-schema on-disk head has no comparable count\n69\t        return None\n70\t\n71\t\n72\tdef checkpoint(store: SpineStore | None = None, *, force: bool = False) -> SignedChainHead:\n73\t    \"\"\"Sign the spine head + advance the durable anti-rollback floor as ONE serialized critical section.\n74\t    The head write and the floor advance are held under a single `floor_lock` so two racing checkpoint()\n75\t    callers cannot leave head.json and floor.json inconsistent, and neither the head nor the floor is ever\n76\t    rolled BACKWARDS by a stale concurrent signer. `force=True` (the `sigil floor reset` path) re-anchors a\n77\t    deliberately SHORTER spine — it skips the monotonic head guard; the caller then force-lowers the floor.\"\"\"\n78\t    store = store or SpineStore()\n79\t    priv, _ = _owner_keys()\n80\t    head = sign_head(store.entries(), engagement_slug=SCOPE, signers=[(OWNER_KEY_ID, priv)])\n81\t    with floor_lock():                                      # serialize head+floor commit across all callers\n82\t        if not force:\n83\t            # MONOTONIC HEAD GUARD: never roll head.json back to a shorter head — a concurrent checkpoint()\n84\t            # that already committed a LONGER head (and advanced the floor to it) would otherwise be undone\n85\t            # on disk, and the (higher) floor would then spurious-TAMPER the shorter head we wrote.\n86\t            disk = _read_head_on_disk()\n87\t            if disk is not None and disk.entry_count > head.entry_count:\n88\t                return disk                                 # our sign is stale; the newer head stands\n89\t        _atomic_write_text(HEAD_PATH, head.model_dump_json())   # FIX 3: never leave a torn head on a crash\n90\t        # Advance the floor UNDER THE SAME LOCK (re-loads prior inside advance -> last-writer-monotonic).\n91\t        # BEST-EFFORT so a floor problem never bricks signing (consolidate + warden-anchor route here too),\n92\t        # AND a not-advanced floor only ever REJECTS MORE — never a false-CLEAN — so warning is fail-SAFE.\n93\t        try:\n94\t            advance_floor(head, _locked=True)\n95\t        except FloorDowngrade as e:                         # the INTENDED downward-refusal (e.g. post-reset) — benign\n96\t            import sys\n97\t            print(f\"warning: durable anti-rollback floor not advanced ({e}); run `sigil floor reset` after \"\n98\t                  f\"a deliberate reset/restore\", file=sys.stderr)\n99\t        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — a REAL IO/write/corrupt-or-wrong-scope-load failure — surface loudly\n100\t            import sys\n101\t            print(f\"ERROR: durable anti-rollback floor WRITE FAILED ({e}) — the floor may be stale; \"\n102\t                  f\"investigate before trusting `sigil verify`\", file=sys.stderr)\n103\t    return head\n104\t\n105\t\n106\tdef classify_head(head: SignedChainHead, entries: list, tr: TrustRoot,\n107\t                  *, floor: Floor | None = None) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n108\t    \"\"\"Pure head/chain classification (no globals — testable in isolation), SNAPSHOT-AWARE for the\n109\t    cold-archive hard-prune. The live window is selected BY SEQ (`seq >= base_seq`), not by array prefix, so\n110\t    every crash-cutover state verifies clean. Failures are TAMPERING (front-truncation, tail-truncation, or\n111\t    a rewrite); a chain grown past the anchor is benign-stale. entry_count stays ABSOLUTE (base_count +\n112\t    live). For a v1 head (base_seq=0, base_count=0) this is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-v2 semantics.\"\"\"\n113\t    base = head.base_count\n114\t    signed_live = head.entry_count - base\n115\t    live = [e for e in entries if e.seq >= head.base_seq]\n116\t    if len(live) < signed_live:\n117\t        return False, (f\"TAMPERING: live window has {len(live)} records but the signed head anchors \"\n118\t                       f\"{signed_live} (truncated/rolled back)\")\n119\t    if signed_live > 0:\n120\t        # LEFT-EDGE PIN — UNCONDITIONAL TAMPERING: the signed live window must start EXACTLY at base_seq and\n121\t        # link from base_prev_hash. This closes the false-CLEAN front-drop hole (the n<entry_count no-op\n122\t        # trap transposed to the left edge) — an attacker cannot drop the front of the live window. (Only\n123\t        # the window-SHAPE check is gated on signed_live>0; the SIGNATURE check below is not.)\n124\t        if live[0].seq != head.base_seq or live[0].prev_hash != head.base_prev_hash:\n125\t            return False, \"TAMPERING: live window does not start at the signed base (front-truncated/rolled back)\"\n126\t    # SIGNATURE / threshold check runs UNCONDITIONALLY — including signed_live == 0 (an empty live window, the\n127\t    # case a forged zero-anchor head presents). verify_head over an empty window still validates\n128\t    # head_hash==base_prev_hash, last_seq==base_seq, entry_count==base_count AND the owner Ed25519 signature,\n129\t    # so a forged UNSIGNED zero head is TAMPERING (the whole tamper-evidence point), while a legitimately\n130\t    # owner-signed empty spine still passes. (An earlier version gated this behind signed_live>0 and thereby\n131\t    # skipped signature verification for empty heads — a keyless tamper-alert-suppression fail-open.)\n132\t    ok, msg = verify_head(head, live[:signed_live], tr, genesis_prev=head.base_prev_hash)\n133\t    if not ok:\n134\t        return False, f\"TAMPERING: history rewritten at or below the signed head — {msg}\"\n135\t    # DURABLE EXTERNAL FLOOR (hard-prune C1) — runs AFTER the in-band signature check, so it only ever\n136\t    # ADDS a rejection: a VALIDLY-signed but STALE head is caught here by the monotonic floor / meta-chain,\n137\t    # which the in-band signature cannot catch on its own. HONEST SCOPE (do not overclaim): this catches a\n138\t    # stale head ONLY when `floor` is a NEWER value the attacker did NOT roll back — i.e. an OUT-OF-BAND\n139\t    # verifier holding a retained floor (a paired device over WireGuard), or the routine `--reset` path\n140\t    # (the floor survives the spine-dir rmtree). It does NOT stop a same-host attacker who can also rewrite\n141\t    # the UNSIGNED floor.json: the local verify reads the floor fresh from that same attacker-controlled\n142\t    # disk, rolling head.json and floor.json back together (see floor.py HONEST LIMIT). No floor -> pass\n143\t    # (byte-identical to pre-floor).\n144\t    ok_floor, floor_msg = check_floor(head, floor)\n145\t    if not ok_floor:\n146\t        return False, f\"TAMPERING: {floor_msg}\"\n147\t    if len(live) > signed_live:\n148\t        return True, f\"anchors {signed_live} records; {len(live) - signed_live} appended since — run `sigil sign` to re-anchor\"\n149\t    return True, f\"anchors all {signed_live} records (current)\"\n150\t\n151\t\n152\tdef verify_checkpoint(store: SpineStore | None = None) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n153\t    store = store or SpineStore()\n154\t    if not HEAD_PATH.exists():\n155\t        return False, \"no signed head — run `sigil sign` to anchor the spine\"\n156\t    raw = HEAD_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n157\t    try:\n158\t        head = SignedChainHead.model_validate_json(raw)     # a future-schema head fails extra=\"forbid\" here\n159\t    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — never crash + never false-clean: distinguish \"too new\" from \"corrupt\"\n160\t        try:\n161\t            sv = int(json.loads(raw).get(\"schema_version\", 1))\n162\t        except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):\n163\t            return False, \"corrupt head — cannot parse (run `sigil sign` to re-anchor)\"\n164\t        if sv > _MAX_HEAD_SCHEMA:\n165\t            return False, f\"head schema v{sv} too new — upgrade sigil (never treated as clean)\"\n166\t        return False, \"corrupt head — cannot parse (run `sigil sign` to re-anchor)\"\n167\t    if head.schema_version > _MAX_HEAD_SCHEMA:\n168\t        return False, f\"head schema v{head.schema_version} too new — upgrade sigil (never treated as clean)\"\n169\t    try:\n170\t        floor = load_floor()                                # None if absent -> byte-identical to pre-floor\n171\t    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — a PRESENT-but-corrupt floor is suspicious; fail CLOSED, never clean\n172\t        return False, f\"durable anti-rollback floor unreadable — refuse to certify (possible tamper): {e}\"\n173\t    return classify_head(head, store.entries(), trust_root(), floor=floor)\n174\t"}]},"uuid":"b85cba47-166a-4736-aef1-5823d1fd8321","timestamp":"2026-07-19T21:53:25.699Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"df4a76ae-4b5b-4975-b473-2b5c9adea417","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

NO prune yet — v1 heads keep base_count=0.\n9\tRun: ~/.sigil/venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_spine_floor.py -q\n10\t\"\"\"\n11\timport pytest\n12\tfrom pydantic import ValidationError\n13\t\n14\tfrom sigil.reuse import AuthorizerKey, TrustRoot, build_chain, digest_payload, generate_keypair\n15\tfrom sigil.reuse.chain import sign_head\n16\tfrom sigil.reuse.models import _GENESIS_PREV, SignedChainHead\n17\tfrom sigil.spine.checkpoint import classify_head\n18\tfrom sigil.spine.floor import (\n19\t    Floor,\n20\t    advance_floor,\n21\t    check_floor,\n22\t    head_sig_hash,\n23\t    load_floor,\n24\t    reset_floor,\n25\t)\n26\t\n27\t\n28\tdef _chain(n: int):\n29\t    return build_chain([digest_payload({\"i\": i}) for i in range(n)])\n30\t\n31\t\n32\tdef _owner():\n33\t    kp = generate_keypair()\n34\t    tr = TrustRoot(threshold=1, authorizers=[AuthorizerKey(key_id=\"owner\", name=\"owner\",\n35\t                                                           public_key_b64=kp.public_key_b64)])\n36\t    return kp, tr\n37\t\n38\t\n39\tdef _floor(last_seq=0, base_seq=0, base_count=0, head_sig_hash=\"\", scope=\"s\", entry_count=None):\n40\t    # entry_count defaults to last_seq+1 (a full non-pruned window) unless a test pins it explicitly.\n41\t    ec = entry_count if entry_count is not None else last_seq + 1\n42\t    return Floor(scope=scope, entry_count=ec, last_seq=last_seq, base_seq=base_seq, base_count=base_count,\n43\t                 head_sig_hash=head_sig_hash)\n44\t\n45\t\n46\tdef _v2_head(**kw):\n47\t    base = dict(schema_version=2, engagement_slug=\"s\", last_seq=10, entry_count=10, head_hash=\"aa\" * 32,\n48\t                base_seq=0, base_prev_hash=_GENESIS_PREV, base_count=0, cumulative_merkle_root=\"\",\n49\t                snapshot_seq=5, prev_head_hash=\"\")\n50\t    base.update(kw)\n51\t    return SignedChainHead(**base)\n52\t\n53\t\n54\t# ---- check_floor: pure reject rules ---------------------------------------------------------------\n55\t\n56\tdef test_no_floor_is_byte_identical_pass():\n57\t    h = _v2_head()\n58\t    assert check_floor(h, None)[0]                          # Only the KERNEL, which holds the WARDEN private\n262\t    key, can anchor.\"\"\"\n263\t    if not _verify_ed25519(_warden_anchor_msg(int(a.count), a.head_hash, a.pubkey), a.sig, a.pubkey):\n264\t        print(\"REJECTED: warden-anchor-set signature invalid (only the WARDEN key may anchor)\", file=sys.stderr)\n265\t        sys.exit(2)\n266\t    store = SpineStore()\n267\t    store.append(kind=\"warden_checkpoint\", source=\"warden\", actor=\"warden\",\n268\t                 payload={\"count\": int(a.count), \"head_hash\": a.head_hash, \"pubkey\": a.pubkey})\n269\t    checkpoint(store)  # re-sign the spine head so the anchor sits under the spine's signature (anti-truncation)\n270\t    print(f\"anchored WARDEN head into spine: count={a.count} head={a.head_hash[:16]}\")\n271\t\n272\t\n273\tdef cmd_warden_anchor_get(a) -> None:\n274\t    \"\"\"Print the highest WARDEN head ever anchored FOR THIS KEY, as JSON {count, head_hash}.\n275\t    FAILS CLOSED (exit 2) if the spine's own integrity does not hold — otherwise a surgical edit\n276\t    to a warden_checkpoint line, or a spine tail-truncation removing recent anchors, would silently\n277\t    lower the high-water and let a rolled-back WARDEN log pass verify. Scoped by pubkey so a key\n278\t    rotation starts a fresh lineage.\"\"\"\n279\t    import json as _json\n280\t    store = SpineStore()\n281\t    ok, msg = store.verify()                       # chain: catches a tampered/deleted anchor record\n282\t    if not ok:\n283\t        print(f\"REJECTED: spine integrity failed — {msg}\", file=sys.stderr)\n284\t        sys.exit(2)\n285\t    hok, hmsg = verify_checkpoint(store)           # signed head: catches spine tail-truncation\n286\t    if not hok and \"TAMPER\" in hmsg.upper():\n287\t        print(f\"REJECTED: spine head tampered — {hmsg}\", file=sys.stderr)\n288\t        sys.exit(2)\n289\t    best_count, best_hash = 0, \"\"\n290\t    for r in store.iter_records():\n291\t        if r.kind == \"warden_checkpoint\" and r.payload.get(\"pubkey\") == a.pubkey:\n292\t            c = int(r.payload.get(\"count\", 0))\n293\t            if c >= best_count:\n294\t                best_count, best_hash = c, r.payload.get(\"head_hash\", \"\")"}]},"uuid":"308458b7-d3ee-4aad-9f28-78fd4f6eb848","timestamp":"2026-07-19T21:53:45.126Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ddccaebf-5c6e-4b6e-86cf-a19cf2e6378b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Re-run \"\n534\t                  \"with --yes to confirm.\", file=sys.stderr)\n535\t            sys.exit(2)\n536\t        store = SpineStore()\n537\t        head = checkpoint(store, force=True)  # owner-key-gated: re-sign the current spine (force: allow a\n538\t        fl = reset_floor(head)                # SHORTER head), then force the floor down to that fresh head.\n539\t        print(f\"durable floor RE-SEEDED to current head: last_seq={fl.last_seq} base_seq={fl.base_seq} \"\n540\t              f\"base_count={fl.base_count}\")\n541\t\n542\t\n543\tdef cmd_budget(a) -> None:\n544\t    \"\"\"Read-only per-agent budget usage (actions / interrupts / provider tokens / USD cost) for a UTC day,\n545\t    derived from the spine (zero-impact). Caps (opt-in, from ~/.sigil/budgets.json) are shown for context.\"\"\"\n546\t    from datetime import datetime, timezone\n547\t\n548\t    from .governor import Governor\n549\t    day = a.day or datetime.now(timezone.utc).date().isoformat()\n550\t    led = Governor(SpineStore()).budget\n551\t    c = led.caps\n552\t    print(f\"# SIGIL budget — {day}\")\n553\t    print(f\"caps: actions={c.daily_actions} interrupts={c.daily_interrupts} \"\n554\t          f\"tokens={c.daily_tokens} cost_usd={c.daily_cost_usd}\")\n555\t    rep = led.report(day)\n556\t    for agent in sorted(rep):\n557\t        u = rep[agent]\n558\t        print(f\"  {agent}: {u['actions']} action(s), {u['interrupts']} interrupt(s), \"\n559\t              f\"{u['tokens']} token(s), ${u['cost_usd']:.4f}\")\n560\t    if not rep:\n561\t        print(\"  (no agent activity)\")\n562\t\n563\t\n564\tdef cmd_doctor(a) -> None:\n565\t    \"\"\"Whole-install self-check: SIGIL_HOME writable, kernel present, Qdrant reachable, keyring, claude.\"\"\"\n566\t    import sys as _sys\n567\t\n568\t    from .config import doctor, effective_config"}]},"uuid":"982bcd90-1d28-4dd7-bfc7-10673cfbada3","timestamp":"2026-07-19T21:53:45.860Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c28b16de-6ba6-410f-adc6-4e88ae52ef52","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
